import numpy as np, json
from robot import tools, target, query, handoff
from ora_lib import current, offset, Point, Direction
import geo2

ARM="left"
FINGER_INNER=0.0444; FINGER_TIP_OUT=0.0540
PERP_TIP=0.011; PERP_UP=0.022
PAD_HALF=0.0075

obs = current()
cam = obs.camera("head")
rgb = np.array(cam.rgb)
if rgb.max() > 1.5: rgb = rgb/255.0
dark = rgb[...,0] < 0.22
Wp,_ = geo2.cam_cloud(obs,"head")
X,Y,Z = Wp[...,0],Wp[...,1],Wp[...,2]
obst = np.isfinite(Z) & ~dark & (Z>0.796) & (Z<0.90) & (X>-0.50) & (X<-0.15) & (Y>-0.26) & (Y<0.10)
OXY = np.column_stack([X[obst],Y[obst]]); OZ = Z[obst]
eggs = geo2.find_eggs_head(obs)
print("eggs:", [(round(e['cx'],4), round(e['cy'],4), round(e['zmax'],4)) for e in eggs])

def boxes(xy, jaw, pad_z, oxy, oz):
    jaw = np.asarray(jaw,float); jaw = jaw/np.linalg.norm(jaw); perp=np.array([-jaw[1],jaw[0]])
    d = oxy - xy
    a = d @ jaw; p = d @ perp
    out=[]
    for s in (1.0,-1.0):
        m_tip = (a*s > FINGER_INNER) & (a*s < FINGER_TIP_OUT+0.004) & (np.abs(p) < PERP_TIP) & (oz > pad_z-PAD_HALF-0.003) & (oz < pad_z+0.020)
        m_up  = (a*s > FINGER_INNER) & (a*s < FINGER_TIP_OUT+0.014) & (np.abs(p) < PERP_UP) & (oz >= pad_z+0.020) & (oz < pad_z+0.060)
        out.append([float(oz[m].max()) if m.any() else 0.0 for m in (m_tip,m_up)])
    return out

best=None
for e in eggs:
    xy = np.array([e['cx'], e['cy']]); pad_z = e['zmax'] - 0.017
    keep = np.hypot(OXY[:,0]-xy[0], OXY[:,1]-xy[1]) > 0.026
    oxy, oz = OXY[keep], OZ[keep]

import sys, numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, query, handoff
from ora_lib import current, offset, Point, Direction
import geo2

ARM="left"
CUP_IDX = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 2
TILT_DEG = 15.0
FINGER_INNER=0.0444; FINGER_TIP_OUT=0.0540; PERP_TIP=0.011; PERP_UP=0.022; PAD_HALF=0.0075

def measure_scene():
    obs = current(); cam = obs.camera("head"); rgb = np.array(cam.rgb)
    if rgb.max() > 1.5: rgb = rgb/255.0
    dark = rgb[...,0] < 0.22
    Wp,_ = geo2.cam_cloud(obs,"head")
    X,Y,Z = Wp[...,0],Wp[...,1],Wp[...,2]
    m = np.isfinite(Z) & ~dark & (Z>0.796) & (Z<0.90) & (X>-0.50) & (X<-0.15) & (Y>-0.26) & (Y<0.10)
    return obs, np.column_stack([X[m],Y[m]]), Z[m], geo2.find_eggs_head(obs)

def boxes(xy, jaw, pad_z, oxy, oz, rmin=0.026):
    keep = np.hypot(oxy[:,0]-xy[0], oxy[:,1]-xy[1]) > rmin
    oxy, oz = oxy[keep], oz[keep]
    jaw = np.asarray(jaw,float); jaw/=np.linalg.norm(jaw); perp=np.array([-jaw[1],jaw[0]])
    d = oxy-xy; a = d@jaw; p = d@perp
    out=[]
    for s in (1.0,-1.0):
        mt = (a*s>FINGER_INNER)&(a*s<FINGER_TIP_OUT+0.004)&(np.abs(p)<PERP_TIP)&(oz>pad_z-PAD_HALF-0.003)&(oz<pad_z+0.020)
        mu = (a*s>FINGER_INNER)&(a*s<FINGER_TIP_OUT+0.014)&(np.abs(p)<PERP_UP)&(oz>=pad_z+0.020)&(oz<pad_z+0.060)
        out += [float(oz[mt].max()) if mt.any() else 0.0, float(oz[mu].max()) if mu.any() else 0.0]
    return out

# park arm out of the basket's view, then measure
obs = current(); p = obs.pose(ARM)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point([-0.46,-0.40,1.12],"world"), approach=Direction([0,0,-1],"world"), jaw_line=p.axis('y'), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("park", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.summary)
obs, OXY, OZ, eggs = measure_scene()
print("eggs:", [(round(e['cx'],4), round(e['cy'],4), round(e['zmax'],4)) for e in eggs])
if not eggs: handoff("no egg found in basket", n=0)
cands=[]
for e in eggs:
    xy = np.array([e['cx'],e['cy']]); pad_z = e['zmax']-0.017
    for adeg in np.arange(0,180,2.5):
        jaw = np.array([np.cos(np.radians(adeg)), np.sin(np.radians(adeg))])
        b = boxes(xy, jaw, pad_z, OXY, OZ)
        cands.append(dict(worst=max(b), egg=e, xy=xy, pad_z=pad_z, deg=float(adeg), jaw=jaw, boxes=b))

if not clean: handoff("no clear grasp direction", best=round(min(c['worst'] for c in cands),4))

th = np.radians(TILT_DEG)
app_t = np.array([0.0, np.sin(th), -np.cos(th)])
egg_c_z = 0.8155

wrist_t = pads - 0.1501*app_t

R = np.column_stack([app_t, jam, zax])

if not rct["results"][0].get("reachable"): handoff("tilted place pose unreachable", res=rct["results"][0])

print("pregrasp", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.summary)
if not r.ok: handoff("pregrasp failed", failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)
obs2, _, _, eggs2 = measure_scene()

if not r.ok: handoff("descend blocked", failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM:"close"}, target_ref="egg")
print("close", r.status, r.measured_opening, r.summary)
if r.measured_opening is None or r.measured_opening < 0.30: handoff("closed empty", opening=r.measured_opening)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point([contact[0],contact[1],1.13],"world"), approach=Direction(DOWN,"world"), jaw_line=Direction(j3,"world"), interaction="precision")}, speed="normal")
print("lift", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.summary)
if not r.ok: handoff("lift failed", failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)
# traverse above the cup with the tilted orientation
over = np.array([cup['cx'], cup['cy'], 1.10])
q_over = np.array([*over, *geo2.quat_from_R(R)])
rco = query("reach_check", arm=ARM, poses=[q_over.tolist()], interaction="free_space")
print("over-cup tilted reach", rco["results"][0].get("reachable"), rco["results"][0].get("reason"))
if not rco["results"][0].get("reachable"): handoff("tilted traverse unreachable")
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(over,"world"), approach=Direction(app_t.tolist(),"world"), jaw_line=Direction(jam.tolist(),"world"), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("traverse", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.summary)
if not r.ok: handoff("traverse failed", failure=r.failure_code, summary=r.summary)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point(wrist_t,"world"), approach=Direction(app_t.tolist(),"world"), jaw_line=Direction(jam.tolist(),"world"), interaction="precision")}, speed="careful")
tp = current().pose(ARM).position
print("place descend", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, np.round(tp.xyz,4), r.summary)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={ARM:"open"}, target_ref="cup%d release"%CUP_IDX)
print("release", r.status, r.measured_opening, r.summary)
p2 = current().pose(ARM)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={ARM: target(Point([p2.position.x,p2.position.y+0.02,1.12],"world"), approach=Direction(app_t.tolist(),"world"), jaw_line=Direction(jam.tolist(),"world"), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
print("retreat", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.summary)
obs3 = current()
Wp,_ = geo2.cam_cloud(obs3,"head"); X,Y,Z = Wp[...,0],Wp[...,1],Wp[...,2]
